description: At the 0.37.0 release head, node bin/rcf.js define readiness --check all exits 0 with chips D1 to D8 passed (D0 notApplicable), the stage-keeper records the freeze, and rcf build bundle --next works without --override. Every failing check at 639f07bb is cleared by chain records written through the CLI (the operator answering the two D1 profile questions); no readiness check is disabled, skipped or loosened, and every defineD4 opt-out and every waived concern carries a reason.
rationale: Operator ruling Q-06 b (10:40Z): WA-08 sanctioned for the 0.37.0 Build only, expiring at the release; the readiness fix is inside 0.37.0. D-09 (audit section 5), F-22; rcf-lite-build-mechanics section 3. The failing set is in the START readiness output of this DEFINE.
title: Readiness D1 to D6 and D8 pass on rcf-lite main and the tree freezes, so the next release bundles with --next
